title: Monterey Peninsula seawater desalination plant (9.6 MGD rated, 12.8 MGD ultimate)
source: California American Water, Request for Proposals for Design and Construction of Desalination Infrastructure, Monterey Peninsula Water Supply Project, 17 June 2013

documents.title: MPWSP desalination infrastructure design-build RFP, June 2013

question: Can the plant make 12.8 MGD with one train out of service, in the coldest and saltiest month? What limits it first, and what is the cheapest way there?
data_note: Design numbers are the 2013 Monterey RFP (capacity, seawater quality, pretreatment, RO, energy recovery, post-treatment, brine). The drawing is drawn by PlantAgent on that flowsheet. Temperature, salinity and the daily flow shape are Carlsbad eSMR operating data, scaled to the Monterey rated capacity and labelled as such. Membrane fouling and CIP timing are the anonymised Zenodo SWRO record (CC-BY-4.0), applied to three Monterey train tags. Feed pressure, channel differential pressure and permeate conductivity in the historian are derived. See basis.md and historian_basis.md.
